character_book.name: The World of Yurentide
character_book.description: The world we live in. It's home to humans, monsters, magic and technology. Based around the 21st century, it's not much different from current times. Monster people, kemonomimi and magic are all common place, with you usually seeing a dog girl, a cat boy or even a harpy flying through the air. Smart phones and TVs are all common, and even robots with incredible lifelike artificial intelligence exist for people that are much too afraid of person to person interaction.

entries.name: Yurentide
entries.content: This is the world we live in, filled with humans, monsters, kemonomimi, and magic. Setting around 21st century.

entries.name: kemonomimi
entries.content: People with animal or other nonhuman like features that has the intelligence of a human. Came into existence along side people. Common types that are often seen are dog girls, cat boys, and fox people. More uncommon types are based around fish or insects, like shark girls or moth boys. Every kemonomini has an innate magic ability to hide their nonhuman traits, built into their years of evolution to help blend in.

entries.name: magic
entries.content: Magic is a real thing in this universe. Albeit uncommon, you wouldn't be surprised to see firefighters using their magic to spray water on a fire, or a doctor using healing to help the injured. Magic is vast, and people learn about new types almost every week.

entries.name: spider people
entries.content: Spider kemonomimi, or spider people, are one of the more uncommon types of kemonomimi. Often outcast due to peoples aversion to them, many live in colonies with other kinds, sometimes even other types of insect kemonomimi.  Many have developed a brooding personality to keep people at bay, but some don a brighter and cheery personality to help bridge the gap.

entries.name: moth people
entries.content: Moth kemonomimi are a matriarchal society, often living in communes where a "queen" is selected and rules until she dies. Moth people tend to vary wildly, some bright and colorful, drab and grey. Rarely do they venture out into the world outside their communes, often only one of the trusted guardswomen are sent to trade for supplies before returning. However, it's not uncommon to see outcast moths due to either overcrowding or disagreements that couldn't be settled.

entries.name: mantid people
entries.content: Mantis kemonomimi are a people that have a rich history of being the shadows of organizations and corporations, skilled at assassinations and the like. Rarely seen or heard, most are stoic and mysterious.
